title: Terrain Map Explainer — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Reference location
scenes.purpose: Establish the map and place the locator on the IDEA peak first.
visuals: Top-down Three.js relief map on a navy sea with an elevation-ramp shader and contour lines
Locator pin drops onto the IDEA summit and its ring expands
North arrow, 2 km scale bar and elevation legend shown at fixed sizes

beats.development: Terrain heights rise from 35% to full, so contour bands spread across the islands; the locator lands on IDEA and the IDEA label appears.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system
Peak = the idea · routes = its connections

scenes.title: Linked terrain section
scenes.purpose: Open the A–IDEA–C section linked to the located place.
visuals: Navy section line traced over the map from A through IDEA to C and labelled SECTION LINE
Camera pitches about 52° into oblique relief with north kept screen-up
A 3D slice cut along the same line rises above the terrain
Section card opens; profile drawn from the same elevation samples, then its labels and scale appear
Dotted leader joins C on the map to the card

beats.development: The section line draws from A through IDEA to C; the SECTION LINE tag and A/C markers appear.
The view tilts into relief, the 3D slice lifts and the section card shows the matching profile, the IDEA elevation, the distance axis and vertical exaggeration.

scenes.title: Focus back to the map
scenes.purpose: Return to the plan view and restore the routes last, then hold the settled map.
visuals: Camera returns to top-down; the slice sinks back into its line and fades
Orange dashed routes draw IDEA–A, IDEA–C, IDEA–D and A–C over the terrain
Route endpoints and the D label appear

beats.development: Tilt returns to plan view while the routes are restored one after another; D node and label appear.
Settled hold: map, locator, section line, routes, scale, legend and both cards are all readable.

findings: Locator first (0.22–0.85 s), section opened second (0.78–1.68 s), routes restored last (1.98–2.55 s), as the style requires.
The camera tilt is a single out-and-back move with no idle drift.
justifiedHolds: 2.55–3.0 s settled reading hold so the cards, scale and legend are readable after the motion.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
No reviewed preview recipes are listed in STYLE.json (tech.preview_recipes absent; the task lists optional recipes as []), so this preview shows the main characteristic action of the Motion Graphic.
Terrain is an illustrative procedural heightfield (four Gaussian hills), not real geographic data; the map, 3D slice and section profile all sample the same elevation function along the same line.
